newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian vehicle sales fell 2.5 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Colombian vehicle sales fell 2.5 pct in March.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 7 Reuter - Colombia's car and truck sales fell 2.5 percent in March over the same month last year to a total of 10,046 vehicles, a survey published by the local subsidiary of General Motors said.
It said vehicle sales were up 2.3 percent in the first quarter compared to the same period last year, however.
Car and truck sales in the three-month period increased by 668 vehicles over 1996 to a total of 29,501 vehicles, the survey said.
It said nearly 40 percent of the cars and trucks sold during the first quarter were imported models.
